# T-3: Preserve gate lifecycle boundaries

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Propagate effective phase and keep tooling failures outside semantic hooks, artifacts, counters, routing, and pre-guard side effects while retaining valid PASS/FAIL behavior.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R5 explicit and inferred phases produce equivalent diagnostics and onError evidence.
- R6 protocol failure leaves semantic artifacts, counters, memory, and routing byte-identical.
- R7 valid PASS/FAIL behavior remains unchanged.
- R8 all target mismatches stop before hooks, agents, cache, and persistence.

## Implementation Notes
Assign the resolved effective phase to shared context before gate work. Route typed protocol failures through registry onError and preserve dispatcher guard ordering; do not add protocol cases to semantic post lifecycle actions.

## Test Strategy
Extend phase inference, retry-counter, dispatcher, and gate E2E tests; add spec-local coverage for protocol failure snapshots, explicit/inferred parity, valid routing parity, and target mismatch byte identity.
